family.description: This entry represents the guanylyltransferase component of the Iron-guanylylpyridinol (FeGP) cofactor biosynthesis protein HcgB [[cite:PUB00098596]]. HcgB transfers the guanosine monophosphate (GMP) moiety from guanosine triphosphate (GTP) to a pyridinol precursor [[cite:PUB00152291]].
family.name: FeGP cofactor biosynthesis protein HcgB, guanylyltransferase
